description: This file provides platform-dependent utility functions for a Web Module Container, including the creation of a module container object via the function 'WebCreateModuleContainer'. It includes licensing and module metadata comments, global includes, and the implementation of a factory function.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE WebCreateModuleContainer(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Web Module Container object handle, given container, owner, and reserved context handles.
